content.value: A 3-phase motor takes 10 KVA at 0.6 power factor lagging from a source of 220 volts. It is in parallel with a balanced delta load having 16 Ω resistance and 12 Ω capacitive reactance in series in each phase. Find total $\mathrm { \Delta V A , }$ power, line current and power factor of the combination. Assume the motor to be Y – connected.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
